title: "Copy Location" context menu action, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a file or folder on the desktop or in a Folder View now offers Copy Location, which copies its path, like in Dolphin.
explanation: The Folder View item context menu (FolderModel::openContextMenu) only had Cut and Copy, which put URLs on the clipboard for pasting files; there was no way to get an item's path as text like Dolphin's Copy Location. The change adds a copyLocation action (edit-copy-path icon, Ctrl+Alt+C, same name and shortcut as Dolphin) after Copy in the item menu, and handles Ctrl+Alt+C in FolderView.qml's key handler. It copies the local paths of the selected items as plain text, one per line, falling back to the displayed URL for non-local items.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: add a Copy Location action to the item menu

Desktop and Folder View items had no way to copy their path, unlike the
same items in Dolphin. Add Dolphin's Copy Location action after Copy,
with its Ctrl+Alt+C shortcut, copying the paths of the selected items.

BUG: 450688

media.caption: Right-click on a desktop file on master: Cut, Copy, Rename, no way to copy its path
With the change: Copy Location (Ctrl+Alt+C) after Copy; clicking it put /home/kdetest2/Desktop/report.txt on the clipboard

reviews.text: Clean, idiomatic implementation of the requested Copy Location action in Folder View, matching Dolphin's label, icon, placement, and Ctrl+Alt+C shortcut while sensibly supporting multi-selection by copying one path per line. Uses localPath() with a display-URL fallback for non-local items and integrates cleanly into both FolderModel and FolderView.qml's key handler. Verified on a live session and against foldermodeltest with clear before/after evidence.
